description: Native coin balance of any address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche, with raw wei and formatted units plus the block it was read at. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.002 USDC on Base)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche. Chain IDs also accepted.
